searchText: <Grzegorz> @CarlBeek have you had a chance to look at the updated specs structure? https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-specs/pull/21 <Grzegorz> sequencer's persistent state PR: https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-sequencer/pull/13 <kevaundray> > <kevaundray> RE your comments on blacklisting; so instead of permanently banning those who timeout of the lobby X times, we allow them to enter and exit freely, and only those who get to the contribution spot and are messing about get permananently banned. I think this also means less code and yeah would be a better UX for those who have bad connections, so sounds good to me (re @Grzegorz: sequencer's persistent state PR: https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-sequencer/pull/13) <Grzegorz> exactly. we only care about timeouts if they were chosen to contribute <Grzegorz> the risk here is when we have a big number of users who login and immediately leave the page (time out) to make the lobby full <Grzegorz> but I think we wanted to have quite large lobby limits anyway, and this risk is partially mitigated by sybil checks anyway <trent_vanepps> Reminder that there is a fortnightly call Thursday 1130 UTC (730 Et) There are plenty of new faces and a ton of activity over the last two weeks, it’s going to be a pretty full call. please DM me if you would like to be added to the calendar invite <kevaundray> Marcin For OAuth, Is localhost a part of the whitelist for redirect URIs? <Marcin> > <Marcin> It is with the keys I'm using, but I haven't given them to you? Can send them later when I get home. (re @kevaundray: Marcin For OAuth, Is localhost a part of the whitelist for redirect URIs?) <philzip> @CarlBeek I think it's better if `potPubkey` in the initial contribution is G2, and not `""`, created a PR here (https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-specs/pull/24). wdyt?

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <Grzegorz> @CarlBeek have you had a chance to look at the updated specs structure? https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-specs/pull/21

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<kevaundray> > <kevaundray>  RE your comments on blacklisting; so instead of permanently banning those who timeout of the lobby X times, we allow them to enter and exit freely, and only those who get to the contribution spot and are messing about get permananently banned.

I think this also means less code and yeah would be a better UX for those who have bad connections, so sounds good to me (re @Grzegorz: sequencer's persistent state PR: https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-sequencer/pull/13)

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <Grzegorz> exactly. we only care about timeouts if they were chosen to contribute

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <Grzegorz> the risk here is when we have a big number of users who login and immediately leave the page (time out) to make the lobby full

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <Grzegorz> but I think we wanted to have quite large lobby limits anyway, and this risk is partially mitigated by sybil checks anyway
